description: This file defines a UI component for a chat interface within an Android application. It contains a Fragment that displays messages and allows sending new messages, with echo functionality. The class `ChatFragment` manages the message list and interaction logic, and includes an inner `ChatAdapter` class for rendering message items.

classes.name: ChatFragment
classes.description: A Fragment providing a simple chat UI with message sending and echo functionality.

classes.name: ChatFragment.ChatAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying chat messages in the UI.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the chat fragment layout to create the UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView and input controls; sets up send button click handling.

methods.name: ChatAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder for chat message display.

methods.name: ChatAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds message data to the ViewHolder UI components, showing sent vs. received messages.
